carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with light dorsal edges and shadowed ventral edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, low-contrast high-luminance blobs scattered across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor irregularities and small notches are visible along the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct pattern of high-luminance blobs is visible on the dorsal surface of the right pectoral fin.
